description:
We’ve got the ultimate upgrade for the toddlers who are all business out on the track. Our featherlight 12 Pro frame sets the pace and comes in Matte Black or an iridescent purple-shifting Aqua for a look worthy of a pro. Then, we added our Carbon Fiber Wheels to keep this exclusive setup as light as possible while giving your rider speed and comfort on all terrains. These premium air-filled tires feature custom Strider alloy hubs with cartridge bearings and a thru-axle for an unbelievably smooth and luxurious ride.
But we didn’t stop there — as bike geeks, we made sure to trick this setup out with a Carbon Fiber Riser Handlerbar that gives toddlers the aura of the coolest biker on the road. The wide grip gives comfort and style without adding too much weight to this racing rig and fits our Mini Grips made to keep those tiny hands hanging on for every radical turn, jump, and wipeout.
Explore these limited-edition combinations to find a bike that brings out their inner superhero and makes them fly on two wheels.
CARBON FIBER WHEELS
Made for Strider-obsessed speed demons, these pneumatic tires feature 10-spoke carbon fiber rims, custom Strider alloy hubs with cartridge bearings, and a thru-axle for a build that’s super specialized and sure to spark that racing obsession early.
CARBON FIBER RISER HANDLEBAR
This carbon fiber handlebar adds plenty of superhero energy to this bike without adding tons of weight! The wider, higher, and more comfortable grip is sure to bring plenty of attitude with it, whether they’re taking on big challenges, racing, or just cruising down the block.
